summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected Greek working source. Both preserve the hospitality, continual service, pure conduct, permanent shelter, divine honor, already-stated place with the angels, and conditional perseverance in serving the Lord. Their notes distinguish the printed conjecture, reported witness alternatives, editorial Latin proposal, and bracketed wording without claiming fresh manuscript verification. Reader-facing “servants” follows current policy. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance is limited to the supplied source and attributed evidence, not authentication of unseen editions or manuscripts or certification of exhaustive collation.
